eagle-1.title: Eagle-1
eagle-1.description: Eagle-1 is the pilot responsible for delivering Eagle-based air support to Helldivers on the battlefield. From the Super Destroyer, Eagle-1 conducts rapid attack runs using weapons selected as Stratagems by the Helldiver.

democracy-officer.title: Democracy Officer
democracy-officer.description: The Democracy Officer serves aboard the Super Destroyer as a representative of Super Earth authority, providing mission guidance and reinforcing the principles of Managed Democracy.

general-brasch.title: General Brasch
general-brasch.description: General Brasch is a celebrated Super Earth military figure who serves as the instructor of the Helldiver Training Facility. He guides new recruits through Helldiver training and also hosts the Brasch Tactics broadcasts shown aboard Super Destroyers. Brasch portrays himself as one of Super Earth's oldest and most experienced war heroes and has become one of the most recognizable public figures associated with the Helldivers.

ship-master.title: Ship Master
ship-master.description: The Ship Master is a crew member stationed aboard each Super Destroyer and is responsible for overseeing the vessel's operations and crew. Located near the extraction elevator, the Ship Master greets returning Helldivers and comments on their mission performance, including casualties, friendly-fire incidents, and recovered samples. Like several Super Destroyer personnel, the Ship Master's individual name varies.

service-technician.title: Service Technician
service-technician.description: The Service Technician is a member of the crew stationed aboard a Helldiver's Super Destroyer. The technician can be found near the ship's engineering and equipment areas and provides additional dialogue about life aboard the vessel, Super Earth society, the Galactic War, and the technology used by the Helldivers. Like the Ship Master and Democracy Officer, the technician is generated with an individual name.

coretta-kelly.title: Coretta Kelly
coretta-kelly.description: Coretta Kelly is a Super Earth television presenter and the primary host of Strohmann News. She delivers reports concerning the Second Galactic War through broadcasts shown aboard Super Destroyers. Kelly also hosts the tabloid program All You Need To Know, with both programs operating under approval from the Ministry of Truth.
aliases: all you need to know host
